title: Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations Billing Terms by Tier
content:
**Business office billing terms for Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations.** The terms below govern how a privately held day is priced in principle and how bed-hold charges are billed, paid and settled.

| Term | Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed | Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed | Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| What a privately held day costs | the private pay schedule's daily rate in effect on that day for the tier of the room held | same | same | same | same | same |
| Bed-hold percent of that daily rate | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Rounding of bed-hold charges | half up to the cent, per charge | same | same | same | same | same |
| When charges are billed | monthly in arrears | same | same | same | same | same |
| Day of the month on which the prior month's charges are billed | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Calendar days after the statement date by which charges are due | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Accepted payment methods | check, ACH, card, trust transfer | same | same | same | same | same |
| Late charges assessed on bed-hold charges | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Prepaid hold days after the release date refunded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| An ended reservation is complete only when its bed-hold charges are settled | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

("same" repeats the entry in the first tier's column.)

**Statement timing (hypothetical month).** Charges for held days in a hypothetical October are billed on the 3rd of November and are due 30 calendar days after that statement date, on the 3rd of December. No late charge is added to a bed-hold charge after that date on any tier.
